review_locator: PMCID:PMC11263352, Locus of (IL-9) control: IL9 epigenetic regulation in cellular function and human disease; PMCID:PMC5225158, The transcription factor network in Th9 cells
primary_title: Smad2/3 and IRF4 play a cooperative role in IL-9-producing T cell induction
decision_basis: The reviews identify a cooperative SMAD2/3–IRF4 mechanism at the Il9 locus; the cited primary demonstrates TGF-beta-dependent SMAD2/3 recruitment and physical interaction with IRF4, reciprocal dependence for Il9 promoter activation, and required histone modifications in Th9 cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the cooperative gene-regulation bridge. SMAD2/3 are required for IRF4 recruitment and Il9 epigenetic activation but are not sufficient to activate the promoter alone; preserve TGF-beta/Th9 and IRF4 context, and do not infer IL-9 protein secretion, IL9R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11263352, Locus of (IL-9) control: IL9 epigenetic regulation in cellular function and human disease
primary_title: BATF3 is sufficient for the induction of Il9 expression and can compensate for BATF during Th9 cell differentiation
decision_basis: The review identifies BATF3–IRF4 as a cooperative Il9-locus complex; the cited primary demonstrates physical BATF3–IRF4 interaction, complex binding at the Il9 promoter, cooperative reporter activation and rescue of Il9 expression in Batf-deficient Th9 cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the cooperative BATF3/IRF4 gene bridge in Th9 cells. Preserve OX40/IL-4/TGF-beta and BATF-family context; do not attribute the edge to BATF3 alone, infer IL-9 secretion or IL9R signaling, or transfer airway/SCI effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3070307, Genomic views of STAT function in CD4 T helper cell differentiation
primary_title: Temporal induction pattern of STAT4 target genes defines potential for Th1 lineage-specific programming
decision_basis: The review identifies IL24 among IL-12/STAT4-induced Th1-associated genes; the cited primary reports STAT4 occupancy at target loci together with strong IL-12/STAT4-dependent Il24 induction in activated CD4 T cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a neutral STAT4-to-IL24 gene-regulation bridge, not an exclusive direct-promoter activation claim. The primary combines locus occupancy with IL-12-dependent induction in Th1 cells; preserve cell-state and stimulus context, and do not infer IL-24 protein secretion, IL20/IL22 receptor signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
